definitions: Unresolved psychological problems or emotional dependencies stemming from one's relationship with their mother.
A man's unhealthy attachment to or dependence on his mother, often leading to difficulties in adult relationships.
examples: His girlfriend broke up with him, citing his mummy issues as the main reason.
He always seeks approval from older women, which some say points to his mummy issues.
She felt he had mummy issues because he constantly compared her to his mother.
